examShortTricks: Trick 1: Greed is the mechanism of doom: the treasure is guarded (poisoned by the dead Chinese crew's trap) — the island punishes covetousness; state the moral.
Trick 2: Atmosphere: heat, silence, the dead bodies — the gothic detail foreshadows the ending; connect one detail to the outcome.
Trick 3: The twist: the 'treasure' they take is already lethal — irony of the prize being the poison; name it explicitly.
practiceQuestions: Q. What is the consequence of the men's greed? (2 marks) — one dies from the poisoned environment/guards' trap; the treasure destroys its seekers.
Q. How does Wells build suspense? (2 marks) — ominous setting details and the dead crew foreshadow danger before the climax.
keyPoints: Greed kills — the Spanish treasure's poisoned environment punishes the treasure hunters.
Gothic atmosphere: the dead man, the lethal forest; link setting to theme.
